desc: Ideation complete: identify relation DP over 16 binary relations as the primary approach.
Derive the exact possible labels d_i in {0,1,2,3} for each transition (a_{i-1}, a_i) when s_i=0 and when s_i=1, and prove that d_N is uniquely determined by the first N degrees.
Encode every binary relation on states {0,1} as a 4-bit mask, and precompute the edge mask for each pair (s,d).
Precompute the deterministic transition of a relation mask under each (s,d) using boolean matrix composition.
Implement the DP over the string: initialize with the identity relation, update counts for all allowed labels d at each position, and reduce modulo 998244353.
Sum the DP values of masks having at least one diagonal bit set, since those correspond to closed walks, and output the result.
Validate the implementation against the samples and small brute-force cases to ensure distinct degree sequences are counted exactly once.
Alternative approach not needed because the relation DP passed sample tests.
